summary: Clearway Energy, Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its subsidiary Swan Purchaser LLC signed a Membership Interest Purchase Agreement on September 23, 2026 with Swan CE Seller LLC, an affiliate of Clearway Energy Group. Purchaser will acquire membership interests in Swan TargetCo LLC, which will indirectly own Swan Solar LLC, developer of a roughly 650 MW solar project in Bates County, Missouri, for a base price of about $230 million cash, subject to model-based adjustments. Closing, expected in third quarter 2028, is conditioned on customary approvals and third-party actions. Watch CEG affiliate-related terms, financing, and long-dated closing risk.
